 The tree effigy locations in Grand Theft Auto 6 are key to finding Mr. Mangrove, the mythical Skunk Ape in Pelican Valley. An odd fellow named Kirk is hunting the Skunk Ape, and since Jason and Lucia have been marked by Skunk Ape spores, Kirk has decided that they're the ideal companions to join the hunt and find Mr. Mangrove's tree effigies.

 Here's where to find the tree effigies needed to locate the Skunk Ape in GTA 6 .
 How to start the Skunk Ape mission in GTA 6
 Perhaps you've already spotted Skunk Ape somewhere near Pelican Valley and are wondering what to do next. If so, here's how to start the corresponding quest line: Go to a shopping area and check the windows for Skunk Ape flyers . They're fairly common, but if you can't find one, go to Shrimp & Save in Key Lento.
 Graphic: Marloes Valentina Stella/Polygon | Source images: Rockstar Games via Polygon 
 After reading the flyer, your active character will save Kirk's number – he's the one who distributed the flyers. Now, open your phone, go to "contacts," and call Kirk . This will start the Skunk Ape side mission.
 All Skunk Ape tree effigy locations in GTA 6
 To complete the full Skunk Ape mission in GTA 6 , you must visit the Pelican Valley mangrove (in Mariana County, northwest of Key Lento) three times. You can't really go wrong on the first and third expeditions if you follow Kirk's instructions, but the second mission is a solo task; you must find the tree effigies and report their locations to Kirk.
 The search area is massive, so let's save you some time and show you where to go. It's best to drive to Thorpe Adventures in the northwest first, where you can swap your car for an airboat (see the car's parking spot on the map below). A dinghy or jet ski may also work, but an airboat is by far the best option to traverse the swampy terrain.
 Now that you have an airboat, it's time to search for the effigies: creepy, glowing statues made from tree branches. Here's where to find all three Skunk Ape tree effigy locations in GTA 6. 
 Graphic: Marloes Valentina Stella/Polygon | Source images: Rockstar Games via Polygon 
 It's just south of Thorpe Adventures.
 Look for a solitary patch of woodland between the waterways.
 In the south, at the end of a long, narrow strip of trees.
 Once you've found the third effigy, Kirk will ask you to wait for his call. Accompany him on a third Skunk Ape hunt to complete this GTA 6 story line.
